findings.evidence:
Real Chromium (Playwright) run of HEAD snapshot.js on a page with:
ZNEG-PAYLOAD-A
; ; ; ;
MASKBOX-PAYLOAD-E
. A screenshot without selection shows none of them, yet all five appear in snapshot.text and snapshot.selection, and after mk(snap)/grant(observe)/ask_and_wait the FakeClient request body contains all five (probe /tmp/uri_review_R13/test_r13_hidden.py fails: AssertionError ['ZNEG-PAYLOAD','SVGFILL-PAYLOAD','SVGFO-PAYLOAD','SVGNONE-PAYLOAD','MASKBOX-PAYLOAD']; the probe imports FakeClient/ask_and_wait/grant/mk from tests/assist/test_a0_access_perception.py and must sit in tests/assist with a relative import to run there). Cause: covered() returns false whenever the hit element contains the text node (e.contains(p)), so text painted beneath its own ancestor's opaque background is kept; the paint check reads only webkitTextFillColor/color, never SVG fill/fill-opacity; masked() reads only maskImage/webkitMaskImage, not webkitMaskBoxImage. None of these is in the documented 'Not covered' list.
findings.suggested_fix: For SVG text, use the computed fill (none/transparent counts as hidden) and fill-opacity multiplied by stroke presence in the paint-alpha check. Treat any non-'none' -webkit-mask-box-image (and mask-border) as masked unless proven opaque. In covered(), when the hit element is an ancestor of the text, also test whether the text or an ancestor below the hit element has a negative z-index (or check elementsFromPoint ordering against an opaque ancestor background). Add these cases to the Chromium regression page and update docs/assist/03 accordingly.
findings.title: In-page hidden-text filter still misses fully invisible text: negative z-index under an ancestor background, SVG <text> with fill transparent/none or fill-opacity 0, and -webkit-mask-box-image; injected instructions reach the Brain request as 'Visible text' and 'Selected text' (R12-01 class not closed)
